datasets.notes: BEA Distribution of Personal Income (DPI) national summary file, income concept: 'Personal income', ranking basis: 'Equivalized Personal Income'. Figures cover 2000-2024 (2024 is provisional; BEA also publishes an experimental 2025 nowcast not included in this summary file's decile-share table but referenced in the BEA published quintile-share table, see notes in README). BEA reports income SHARES by decile/quintile (fraction of total income received by each group) and summary statistics (mean, median, Gini, percentile ratios, top 1%/5% shares) rather than dollar-value percentile thresholds; therefore the 'percentiles' field is null and a 'decile_income_shares' field is provided instead. Mean and median are 'equivalized' (adjusted for household size) personal/disposable personal income per NIPA Table 2.9 methodology, reported in both nominal USD and constant 2017 USD. Values for Mean/Median converted from BEA's reported dollar figures; decile shares and top 1%/5% shares are fractions of total (e.g., 0.160 = 16.0%).
